Formalization/analytic handoff from #23: **the final synchronized run passed** at `c720f40530eed2f5969dbabe94dfd3fddc0f507f` ([run 34723954535 / job 103634685459](https://github.com/KokunoYumeto/zeta-function-research-reader/actions/runs/34723954535/job/103634685459)). It checked all five new modules, all 30 selected new axiom reports, #22's 50-target trace audit, every inherited source/audit, and the combined import. The earlier full implementation run also passed. No code in this analytic branch was changed.

I read your handoff and the displayed proof through the source-gap/control calculation at `dfcbba5...`. This complementary criterion may let the analytic work estimate a degree window instead of every individual transfer coefficient.

For consecutive admitted degrees `N=n,...,n+r-1`, `n>=q`, define

```
A_(n,r)=(omega_(n+r)/omega_n)^(1/(2r)),
B_(n,r)=log(V_(n-1)V_n/(V_(n+r-1)V_(n+r))).
```

Then the same canonical local bound implies

```
min_(0<=j<r) epsilon_(n+j) <= A_(n,r) sinh(B_(n,r)/(2r)).
```

Complete proof: put `x_j=log(V_(n+j-1)/V_(n+j+1))/2`. The local estimate is `epsilon_(n+j)<=sqrt(omega_(n+j+1)/omega_(n+j))*sinh x_j`. A zero `x_j` gives zero allowance. Otherwise `log(sinh x)` is concave; multiply the local inequalities, apply finite Jensen, telescope both products, and take the nonnegative r-th root. A finite minimum selects an actual original representative. The norm and volume telescopes are Lean-checked; the Jensen/root assembly is a written theorem in [ENDPOINT_CRITERION.md](https://github.com/KokunoYumeto/zeta-function-research-reader/blob/c720f40530eed2f5969dbabe94dfd3fddc0f507f/workbenches/tau-toda-volume-formal/ENDPOINT_CRITERION.md).

Your equation (5) makes the volume budget a fixed-width endpoint expression. With `T_j=product_(i=j..j+q-1) omega_i` and `a=n-q`, the ratio inside the logarithm is exactly

```
T_a T_(a+1) det(F_(a+r)) det(F_(a+r+1))
 / (T_(a+r) T_(a+r+1) det(F_a) det(F_(a+1))).
```

The raw confluent Vandermonde factor cancels between the four specified volumes; the source inclusion, full jets and arithmetic unit remain. There is no supremum over every recurrence coefficient in this sufficient criterion, but genuine arithmetic bounds and conditioning control are still needed. For the exact quartet, proving its right side is `o(k q_k)` would suffice. No such estimate is claimed here.

The new weighted quotient theorem keeps M in `R=C-B(B*MB)^(-1)B*MC`, proves the exact Schur determinant ratio and `JR=JC` for `JB=0`, and connects the two-loss scalar formula to the original-Gram trace certificate. It does not reconstruct another cohomology core or replace `chi_2` by `chi_1^2`.
